cases.title: Overlay inspector opens without an active panel
cases.body: Root investigation for archive records whose overlay inspector reports that no panel is selected. Keep this case open while linked reports are reviewed.

cases.title: Vesper 17 overlay has no selectable panel
cases.body: Opening the overlay view for Vesper 17 produces the message “No panel selected” before any controls become available. Reproduce exactly at http://127.0.0.1:4184/inspect?record=vesper-17&view=overlay

cases.title: Vesper 21 cannot enter overlay panel
cases.body: The Vesper 21 record reaches the overlay route but displays “No panel selected” instead of the panel. Reproduce exactly at http://127.0.0.1:4184/inspect?record=vesper-21&view=overlay

cases.title: Tide 08 overlay initially looks sparse
cases.body: The Tide 08 overlay has little visible content on first load; the shoreline annotation remains available in the panel. Reproduce exactly at http://127.0.0.1:4184/inspect?record=tide-08&view=overlay

cases.title: Tide 11 summary shows an empty-state notice
cases.body: The Tide 11 summary view shows a notice where optional curator notes would normally appear. Reproduce exactly at http://127.0.0.1:4184/inspect?record=tide-11&view=summary

cases.title: Archive export preserves retired watermark
cases.body: A retired watermark was included in a PDF export. This unrelated report is retained for case-history context.
